sections.title: Might Crystal sources
sections.note: 85 sources, 150 Might Crystals in total. Spend them at Lueburry's House in Suthorn Forest.

items.name: Suthorn Ruins boss
items.howTo: Received after defeating Seismic Talus and mending the Stilled Suthorn Forest rift.

items.name: Stilled Lower Suthorn Forest
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Lower Suthorn Forest rift.

items.name: Suthorn Prairie pond
items.howTo: In the pond with three Octoroks: dive and cut the seaweed in the middle of the ring of seaweed.

items.name: Southeast Suthorn Forest ledge
items.area: Southeast Suthorn Forest (high ground reached from Lake Hylia)
items.howTo: Follow the raised part of the forest east of Lake Hylia south to its end; cut the thick grass (plant) on the ledge northeast of the Mini-Moldorms.

items.name: Finding the Flying Plant
items.howTo: Side quest "Finding the Flying Plant": show Jacint a Peahat Echo.

items.name: Rock south of Castle Town
items.area: Ledge south of Hyrule Castle Town (northwest of the Suthorn Prairie north exit)
items.howTo: Lift the Rock in the middle of four grass patches on the ledge.
items.notes: Game8 #12: rock in a cross of grass southwest of Castle Town's southern waypoint.

items.name: Grass west of Castle Town's south waypoint
items.area: High ground west of Castle Town's southern waypoint (northeast of the grove east of Hyrule Ranch)
items.howTo: Cut (spin through) the lone patch of thick grass on the high ground.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon and Game8 #13 say grass/bush; Zelda Wiki lists it as lifting a Rock south of Castle Town.

items.name: Holmill dig in the grove
items.area: Grove east of Hyrule Ranch (northwest part)
items.howTo: Have a Holmill dig in the dirt patch in the northwest part of the round grove east of Hyrule Ranch (southwest of Castle Town).

items.name: Grass south of Hyrule Ranch
items.area: High ground just south / southwest of Hyrule Ranch
items.howTo: Cut the patch of thick grass in the middle of the raised area.

items.name: Ignizol pit
items.area: Pit south of Castle Town's west bridge
items.howTo: Leave Castle Town by the west bridge and go south to a pit full of Ignizols (Zols); cut the thick grass on the plateau in its middle.

items.name: Plus-shaped rocks
items.area: Between Hyrule Ranch and Hyrule Castle Town (west of Castle Town)
items.howTo: Lift the middle rock of five arranged in a plus sign.

items.name: Riverbank boulder
items.area: Across the river southeast of Castle Town (north of the waterfall into Lake Hylia)
items.howTo: Move the Boulder on the riverbank to reveal the crystal.

items.name: Boulder on the road to Lake Hylia
items.area: Southeast of Castle Town, toward the bridge to Lake Hylia
items.howTo: Leave Castle Town by the east bridge and head south toward the Lake Hylia bridge; move the Boulder in the southwest of that area.

items.name: Stone circle southwest of Kakariko
items.howTo: Lift the Rock in the middle of the ring of boulders on the brown hill.

items.name: Cave west of Hyrule Ranch
items.area: Cave west of Hyrule Ranch (near the Wasteland)
items.howTo: Treasure chest inside the cave, southeast of the lake with the Piece of Heart pillars.

items.name: Arrow in the grass
items.howTo: Cut the thick grass the big arrow-shaped grass pattern points to.

items.name: Far western rock
items.area: Far western edge of Hyrule Field (Wasteland)
items.howTo: Lift the Rock by the western border of the map.

items.name: Acorn Gathering (west of Castle Town)
items.area: West of Hyrule Castle Town (outside the wall)
items.howTo: Minigame: pay the man in the acorn hat 10 Rupees and gather all acorns in under 17 seconds.

items.name: Royal-Family Shortcut
items.area: Royal-Family Shortcut (stairs in the ruins west of Castle Town)
items.howTo: Go down the staircase in the ruins west of Castle Town into the shortcut waterway from the prologue; the crystal is inside.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki: in a chest; Zelda Dungeon: lying on the floor; Game8: clear the rift there first.

items.name: Flag Race: short course
items.howTo: Minigame: finish the Flag Race short course in under 17 seconds.

items.name: Stilled Carrot Patch
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Carrot Patch rift during the side quest "Impa's Gift".

items.name: Stilled Northern Sanctuary
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Northern Sanctuary rift.

items.name: Stilled Southern Hyrule Field
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Southern Hyrule Field rift during the side quest "From the Heart" (Hyrule Castle Town).

items.name: Rock south of Eastern Temple
items.area: Eastern Hyrule Field (hill south / southeast of the Eastern Temple)
items.howTo: Climb the hill (e.g. with a Crawltula) and lift the Rock.

items.name: Rock east of Eastern Temple
items.area: Eastern Hyrule Field (cliff east of the Eastern Temple entrance)
items.howTo: Lift the Rock on the high ground east of the canyon leading to the Eastern Temple.

items.name: Holmill dig near Dampé Studio
items.area: Eastern Hyrule Field (high ground southeast of Dampé Studio)
items.howTo: Have a Holmill dig the dirt patch in the middle of the four white flowers.

items.name: Rock near Dampé Studio
items.area: Eastern Hyrule Field (small cliff north-west of Dampé Studio)
items.howTo: Lift the Rock among four immovable stones on the cliff.

items.name: Cave north of Dampé Studio
items.area: Eastern Hyrule Field (cave north-east of Dampé Studio)
items.howTo: Bind the rock out of the way, then press the switch (e.g. with an Armos or a distant Old Bed) to lift the bars and open the chest.

items.name: Lake Hylia underwater boulder
items.area: Lake Hylia (southwest of the Great Fairy Shrine)
items.howTo: Underwater beneath a large rock; Bind it out of the way.

items.name: Great Fairy Shrine chest
items.howTo: Open the chest that appears in the Great Fairy Shrine; this starts "The Great Fairy's Request".
items.after: After The Rift on Eldin Volcano, all Accessory slots upgraded and Might Crystals explained by Lueburry

items.name: Stilled Lake Hylia
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Lake Hylia rift.

items.name: Kakariko graveyard dig
items.howTo: Have a Holmill dig the dirt patch by the tree on the west side of the graveyard.

items.name: A Curious Child
items.howTo: Side quest "A Curious Child": show Euca a Zol, an Ignizol and a water-swollen Hydrozol Echo.

items.name: Under the weather vane
items.area: Hyrule Castle Town (weather vane by the main road)
items.howTo: Bind the bird weather vane out of the way; a ladder leads down to a room with the chest.

items.name: Hyrule Castle boss
items.howTo: Received after defeating Ganon and mending the Stilled Hyrule Castle Town rift.

items.name: Hyrule Castle roof
items.howTo: Lying in plain sight on the castle roof; climb up with a Platboom.

items.name: Desert entrance ledge
items.area: Canyon entrance to the Gerudo Desert (north ledge)
items.howTo: Right after entering the canyon from Suthorn Prairie, lift the Rock on the ledge to the north.
items.notes: Game8 files this one under Suthorn Prairie.

items.name: Rock on a dead tree
items.area: Canyon entrance to the Gerudo Desert (north side)
items.howTo: Move the Rock sitting on top of a dead tree on the north side of the entrance canyon.

items.name: Southeast sand mound
items.area: High ground east of the southern ruins
items.howTo: Blow away the Loose-Sand Mound with a Wind Cannon.
items.after: After learning the Wind Cannon Echo

items.name: Southern ruins locked room
items.area: Southern ruins (cave where the Wind Cannon is first learned)
items.howTo: Chest in a locked room in the southern desert ruins; uncover and press the switch hidden under a sand dune to open the room.
items.notes: Missing from Zelda Wiki's table (which sums to 148); listed by Game8 (#22) and Zelda Dungeon.

items.name: Cliff east of the Oasis
items.area: High ground east of the Oasis
items.howTo: Lift the Rock on the cliff top.

items.name: Cave northwest of the Oasis
items.area: Cave near the Ancestor's Cave of Rest waypoint
items.howTo: From the Ancestor's Cave of Rest waypoint go right into another cave, defeat the monsters and follow the path out to a cliff with a chest.

items.name: Cliff northwest of the Oasis
items.area: High ground on the north side of the canyon, northwest of the Oasis
items.howTo: Lift the Rock on the raised area.

items.name: Holmill dig by the Boarblin outpost
items.area: High ground by the northwest Monster Outpost
items.howTo: Have a Holmill dig the sand patch east of the Boarblin Monster Outpost.

items.name: Gerudo Sanctum boss
items.howTo: Received after defeating Mogryph and mending the Stilled Gerudo Sanctum rift.
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert

items.name: Elusive Tumbleweeds
items.howTo: Side quest "Elusive Tumbleweeds": use Bind to bring the Gerudo woman a tumbleweed.

items.name: Stilled Desert Temple Ruins
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Desert Temple Ruins rift (part of A Rift in the Gerudo Desert).

items.name: Stilled Northern Gerudo Desert
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Northern Gerudo Desert rift.

items.name: Mango Rush: Vibrant
items.howTo: Minigame: collect all 60 Tough Mangoes on Vibrant seeds difficulty.

items.name: Jabul Ruins boss
items.howTo: Received after defeating Vocavor and mending the Stilled Jabul Waters rift.

items.name: Stilled Upper Zora River
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Upper Zora River rift (part of Chaos at River Zora Village).

items.name: Stilled Eastern Zora River
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Eastern Zora River rift in the northeast of Zora River.

items.name: Holmill dig north of Seesyde
items.howTo: Have a Holmill dig the dirt patch next to the purple flowers, by a tree north of the Seesyde Village waypoint.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon files this under Hyrule Field (southwest of Zora's River).

items.name: Under the Seesyde dock
items.howTo: Underwater beneath the dock / bridge on the south side of Seesyde Village.

items.name: A Treat for My Person
items.howTo: Side quest "A Treat for My Person": wear the Cat Clothes and bring the cat a Warm Mixed Special for its person.

items.name: Zora Cove bombable rock
items.area: Zora Cove seafloor (west of Sea Zora Village)
items.howTo: Underwater: blow up the cracked rock / floor tile with a Bombfish Echo.

items.name: Zora Cove seaweed ring
items.area: Zora Cove (northeast of Sea Zora Village)
items.howTo: Underwater: cut the seaweed in the middle of a ring of seaweed.

items.name: Chest above the Jabu-Jabu waterfall
items.area: Zora River (north of Lord Jabu-Jabu's Den)
items.howTo: Chest hidden among trees above the more westerly of the two waterfalls behind Lord Jabu-Jabu's Den.

items.name: Zora River Monster Outpost
items.area: Monster Outpost in western Zora River (southwest of River Zora Village)
items.howTo: Defeat the Moblins at the outpost to unlock the outpost chest.

items.name: Eldin Temple boss
items.howTo: Received after defeating Volvagia and mending the Stilled Eldin Volcano rift.

items.name: Stilled Goron City
items.howTo: Mend the rift in the cave in Goron City (talk to the worried Goron in front of it).

items.name: Stilled Western Eldin Volcano
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Western Eldin Volcano rift.

items.name: Eldin Volcano Trail outpost
items.area: Lizalfos camp by the waypoint in southwest Eldin Volcano Trail
items.howTo: Defeat the Lizalfos at the camp to unlock the outpost chest.

items.name: Ledge east of Goron City
items.area: Cliff ledge directly east of Goron City
items.howTo: Treasure chest on the ledge at the eastern edge of the cliffs; jump down to it.

items.name: Northwest chest
items.howTo: Climb to the top of the northwest cliffs and head right; defeat the Lizalfos Lv. 2 guarding the chest.

items.name: Northeast ledge rock
items.area: Final ledge northeast of Goron City (bordering the Eternal Forest)
items.howTo: From Goron City keep descending ledges to the northeast (Water Blocks / Old Beds help) and lift the Rock on the last ledge.
items.notes: Game8 files this under the Eternal Forest (reached with a Peahat from a steam vent).

items.name: The Flames of Fortune
items.area: Hot spring in northwest Eldin Volcano / Goron City
items.howTo: Side quest "The Flames of Fortune" (Ondes): carry the burning coal from near the Rock-Roast Quarry to Limme outside Goron City without letting it go out.

items.name: Glide Path Trailblazer
items.howTo: Side quest "Glide Path Trailblazer" (Disian): finish the glide course without touching the ground, using a flying Echo and the updrafts.

items.name: Lanayru Temple boss
items.howTo: Received after defeating Skorchill and mending the Stilled Holy Mount Lanayru rift.

items.name: Stilled Hebra Mountain Cave
items.howTo: Mend the rift in the cave next to Condé's House.

items.name: Stilled Hebra Mountain Passage
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Hebra Mountain Passage rift (side quest "Stamp Stand Swallowed!").

items.name: Icicle above the Ice Block cave
items.area: Icicle field, ledge above the Ice Block cave (lower north area)
items.howTo: Melt the ice around the crystal (e.g. with an Ignizol or Brazier) in the grass patch on the ledge above the cave.

items.name: Southern grass rock
items.area: Southernmost part of the mountain's base
items.howTo: Lift the Rock in the grass patch (Wolfos nearby); this area is skipped when following Condé, so come back for it.

items.name: Cliff behind Condé's House
items.area: Cliff north / northeast of Condé's House
items.howTo: Melt the ice around the crystal on the cliffside.

items.name: Ledge east of the Smoothie Shop
items.area: Ledge just east of the Hebra Smoothie Shop
items.howTo: Melt the ice around the crystal in the grass patch among the trees.
items.notes: Game8's matching entry says a clearing in the west reached by Flying Tile.

items.name: Snowball slope
items.howTo: Melt the ice around the crystal in the middle of the rolling-snowball section on the way to the peak.

items.name: Faron Temple boss
items.howTo: Received after defeating Gohma and mending the Stilled Faron Wetlands rift.
items.after: A Rift in the Faron Wetlands

items.name: Stilled Heart Lake
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Heart Lake rift (the Deku Scrub waits in front of it).

items.name: Stilled Blossu's House
items.howTo: Mend the Stilled Blossu's House rift.

items.name: Mobbing Mothulas!
items.howTo: Side quest "Mobbing Mothulas!": defeat the Mothulas south of Scrubton and pull the stuck Deku Scrub out of the ground.

items.name: Behind the cobweb
items.howTo: In an alcove behind cobwebs by the northeastern water; burn the web (e.g. stack beds and put a Brazier on top).

items.name: Flowerbed near Blossu's House
items.area: Ledge west-north-west of Blossu's House (south of Scrubton)
items.howTo: Cut the middle plant of the round flowerbed on top of the cave entrance.

items.name: Western flowerbed
items.howTo: Cut the middle plant of the round flowerbed on a small patch of land in the western forest.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki places it north of Heart Lake.

items.name: Deku Scrub Lockup underwater
items.howTo: At the far east end of the underwater section, move the boulder aside and block or ride past the down-current (e.g. with a Platboom) to grab the crystal.
items.after: During/after A Rift in the Faron Wetlands (Stilled Blossu's House)

items.name: Eternal Forest ledge
items.area: Ledge near the central Eternal Forest waypoint
items.howTo: Climb onto the trees (e.g. with Water Blocks) to the ledge by the central waypoint and cut the middle patch of thick grass.

sections.title: Lueburry's upgrades
sections.note: Swordfighter Form upgrades: 125 crystals for everything, plus 25 for the final reward.

items.name: Sword of Might
items.howTo: Enhance at Lueburry's machine.
items.after: Unlocked after Suthorn Ruins; Lv. 3 after Still Missing

tiers.name: Lv. 2
tiers.reward: More sword damage and a bigger Spin Attack

tiers.name: Lv. 3
tiers.reward: Sword Beam at full health, more damage and a bigger Spin Attack

items.name: Bow of Might
items.howTo: Enhance at Lueburry's machine.
items.after: Bow obtained in the Gerudo Sanctum; Lv. 3 after Still Missing

tiers.name: Lv. 2
tiers.reward: Spreadshot (hold X), more damage, range and arrow speed

tiers.name: Lv. 3
tiers.reward: More damage, range and arrow speed

items.name: Bombs of Might
items.howTo: Enhance at Lueburry's machine.
items.after: Bombs obtained in the Eldin Temple; Lv. 3 after Still Missing

tiers.name: Lv. 2
tiers.reward: Bombchu (hold A), more damage and a bigger blast

items.name: Energy gauge
items.howTo: Enhance at Lueburry's machine.
items.after: Unlocked after Suthorn Ruins; Lv. 3-4 after Still Missing

items.name: Lueburry's last creation
items.howTo: After every upgrade above is maxed, bring Lueburry the last 25 Might Crystals (all 150 found).
items.reward: A Might Crystal pot/statue outside his house that fully refills Swordfighter Energy
